annotations.title: Where the surf is good now

description: Where the surf is good around the world in the next days: every town whose best day from today up to within_days ahead is at least min_rating, best first and soonest of equals, each with that day (rating Flat … Epic at its best spot, the spot, its best time, the surf in surfers' words, how sure the forecast is, and when: today, tomorrow or the weekday in the town's own time) and today's rating. Best first weighs the place in: the day's rating times how good the town's waves are all year (yearSurf: its measured % of Good and of Great days over three years, and rank, where that stands among Swell Cabin's towns from 0 to 1; null where not measured, counted as the middle), so a Great day where the surf is often good (Uluwatu) comes before a Great day where it seldom is (Tel Aviv). From Swell Cabin's forecast for every town, worked out twice a day (generated says when; stale is true when it is more than 36 hours old). Use it for "where is it good right now / this weekend", then surf_forecast for one town's full forecast, and share each town's url.
